title_en: Watch Out for Phone and Online Scams
note_en: In 信息就可能被偷走 "the information may be stolen," 被 marks the passive: the thing affected comes first, and the doer (if mentioned) goes right after 被: 被骗子偷走 "stolen by scammers." Unlike English, Chinese uses 被 mostly for unwelcome events, which is why it keeps appearing in this text: 被骗 "be scammed," 被偷走.
